page.layout: One printed page: a title page with an engraved woodcut border on all four sides. Inside the frame, centred: a Hebrew line at the top, then the title block in roman, Greek and italic type, then the printer's imprint and date below a rule. No margin notes. A handwritten "24" at top right and library stamps are not printed text.

l.i: Ad diem XIIII. Februarij, loco horisq; Medi-

page.notes: The Hebrew line at the top is small and worn; the reading יחוד is uncertain. The Greek lines are copied in capitals as printed; "ΥΓΙΕΙΑΣ" and "ΠΑΝΑΚΕΙΑΣ" have a worn apostrophe-like mark in the scan. The date is printed as "cIↄ Iↄ xciii" with reversed-C numerals and is given as MDXCIII. The page number "24" at top right is handwritten, not printed, so it is left out. The "Catalog" label and the University of Basel library stamp are also left out. The engraved border has no text.
